scope: Read-only source/test/retained-evidence check of actual production803 preview announcement lifecycle; no new runtime.
findings: RandomizerPreview runs spinResult against the current draft and mounts real keyed RandomizerSequence; no config save or persistence is performed by Spin.

RandomizerStage handleComplete deduplicates the current keyed run, sets resolved=true and invokes current parent callback. RevealFrame always renders role=status aria-atomic=true sr-only text from resolved announcement context; WinnerCard show/opacity does not own or clear that status.
Sequence handleBuildComplete schedules future timers only. It does not set units/done immediately or invoke outer onComplete, so no same-batch parent unmount can discard the resolved state update.

With eligible openingUnits under normal preference, status remains in the mounted build stage throughout1100ms hold; build-exit then hides/fades its visual wrapper and the stage remains mounted until1100+320+160=1580ms, when units replace it.

With eligible openingUnits under reduced preference, hold is700ms and zero exit/gap timers replace build stage at700ms. The resolved status therefore has a700ms source-defined mounted hold, rather than synchronous unmount.

Without openingUnits, handleBuildComplete returns without scheduling transition, keeping resolved build status/result mounted. New spin remounts/clears live text; old completion is rejected by active/completed guards.

Sequence cleanup effect returns timer cleanup rather than clearing timers on mount, preserving completion scheduled by a child first effect. Existing test explicitly covers synchronous reduced completion, normal hold/exit/gap and old-run timer retirement.

evidenceQualification.stageBrowser: Retained fixture.mjs imports and mounts RandomizerStage directly, not RandomizerSequence. Actual weighted engine output in observed fixtures has openingUnits:null. It covers actual stage/reveal timers, completion, once-only resolved DOM announcements and OS/page motion, plus explicit cancel/reset lifecycle.
evidenceQualification.sequenceUnit: Existing RandomizerSequence.test.tsx mocks RandomizerStage and UnitRandomizerStage; it proves parent timer/phase order but is not actual Stage+Sequence browser integration or speech acceptance.
evidenceQualification.sourceConclusion: No batching/immediate-unmount defect found. Expected full preview transition explains a transient status window, but does not prove a particular live locator missed it for that reason.
evidenceQualification.live: Root observed live initial status empty and preview sequence clearing. Live resolved announcement was not observed by this reviewer or claimed by this receipt; no assistive-technology speech test claimed.
